description: This Java source file defines the class DatabaseIT, which appears to be an integration test class for database-related operations within the OpenMRS project. It includes setup and teardown methods, database initialization, and utilities for managing Liquibase migrations and database cleanup.

classes.name: DatabaseIT
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class for managing database setup, migrations, and cleanup during integration tests in the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares the database environment before each test by initializing the database.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the database after each test by dropping all objects.

methods.name: getLiquibase
methods.description: Creates and returns a Liquibase instance configured with the specified changelog file.

methods.name: initializeDatabase
methods.description: Configures the database for tests, setting up in-memory or container-based databases as needed.

methods.name: setupContainerDB
methods.description: Ensures a database container is running and updates the connection URL.

methods.name: updateDatabase
methods.description: Runs Liquibase migrations using the specified changelog file.

methods.name: dropAllDatabaseObjects
methods.description: Drops all objects from the database, handling different database types like PostgreSQL and MySQL.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Establishes and returns a new database connection with auto-commit disabled.

methods.name: useInMemoryDatabase
methods.description: Checks system properties to determine whether to use an in-memory database for testing.
